result.keywords: This fictional conference paper describes a moon-based archival method for classifying intermittent telemetry into discrete bins using an adaptive lattice scheduler. The approach targets low-bandwidth relay networks, emphasizing storage compaction, signal cadence normalization, and long-horizon fault tolerance. A simulated case study compares the method against baseline buffering in a remote observatory setting.
result.title: Lattice Kestrels for Lunar Signal Binning.
